pattern_title: Auth code distribution shifts must be validated before action
pattern_description: A large share of the apparent cost change is tied to shifts in authorization coding distribution rather than a clear utilization or reimbursement signal. This appears in TX and again in UNATTRIBUTED / VA, so the first business step is to confirm how authorization status is being mapped onto claims before changing policy, contracting, or UM operations.

pattern_title: TX DSNP acute hospital admissions are the main paid-cost driver
pattern_description: TX DSNP HMO acute hospital spend is the clearest real cost trend in the analysis and is driven first by more admissions, with some added pressure from higher paid and allowed per admit. The signal is concentrated in authorization-required acute hospital claims, so the most likely lever is inpatient utilization management rather than broad product repricing alone.
